name: OPPO / OnePlus / realme ColorOS
manual: Desktop card 应用建议: long-press the card, 移除卡片, 移除.
Desktop stack 小布建议: long-press, 服务推荐设置, turn off 资讯服务 and 赛事服务; keep 出游/外卖/课程 reminders. Do not use 卸载小布建议: the weather card lives in this stack.
Browser search box hot words: no switch in the tablet browser (40.10).
